info.name: SlideLogic
info.summary: Open and edit presentations in SlideLogic
info.description: Open PowerPoint presentations (.pptx, .potx, .ppsx) from Files in SlideLogic, an open-source presentation app by Aegean Logic that runs in the browser. Everyone who opens the same presentation edits it together, live. Saving writes the presentation back to Nextcloud; Export and Save As put PDFs, pictures and copies next to it.
info.author: Aegean Logic
